[Thinking]
**Crafting LinkedIn Post**

I need to write a professional and enthusiastic LinkedIn post. I want to mention my involvement with a member of the CDS Hooks PMC and highlight my work with the standard since 2017. I’m excited about helping move this standard forward!  

I’ll include a call to action: if anyone is using it, please add your implementation to the wiki link. If not, I'm available as a freelance consultant for implementation assistance.  

It’s important to keep the formatting light and concise, maybe using some emojis. Let's go for 3-5 short paragraphs!
[/Thinking]

Thrilled to share that I’ve joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! I’ve been working with CDS Hooks since 2017, and I’m excited to help move the standard forward and support the community that’s building with it.

If you’re already using CDS Hooks, please add your implementation to the community list: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability. Visibility helps us all learn from each other and demonstrate real-world adoption.

If you’re considering CDS Hooks or planning an implementation, I’m available as a freelance consultant to help with strategy, design, and delivery. Feel free to reach out!
